en: Sinocapritermes fujianensis is recorded from Jianou in Fujian, from Guangxi and from Guangdong. The account available here contains only the plate captions for the soldier head and pronotum in dorsal view, the head in profile, the postmentum and the mandible, so no continuous morphological description of the soldier, alate or worker can be reconstructed. The species is therefore characterized in this entry by its distribution alone, pending a fuller source text.
